text: So Alex, it is peak humpback whale season along the Queensland coast, which means spots like the Gold Coast and Hervey Bay are absolutely buzzing with sightings. Mums and calves are making their way south and whale watchers are reporting bumper numbers this year.

speaker: charlie
text: Love that, it's basically our own version of a spring migration parade, minus the marching band. Meanwhile on the power front, all that spring sunshine has pushed rooftop solar generation to a fresh record, which is good news for anyone who likes watching their electricity meter run backwards.

speaker: alice
text: It really is a nice little one two punch, wildlife thriving and households saving. Two very different kinds of solar powered energy if you think about it, one's got a blowhole and the other's on your roof.
